task.description:
Update documentation after PD-08 is released.

1. **`docs/status/requirement_status.json`** — update the `PD-08` entry:
   ```json
   "PD-08": {
     "status": "RELEASED",
     "stage": 2,
     "priority": "MUST",
     "title": "Definition snapshot",
     "implemented_in": ["src/definition/snapshot.zig"],
     "test_spec": "tests/specs/PD-08.md",
     "test_run": "WF02-pd08-20260521-run-01",
     "tested_at": "2026-05-21",
     "released_at": "2026-05-21",
     "release_run": "WF02-pd08-20260521",
     "last_updated": "<ISO8601 timestamp>"
   }
   ```

2. **`CHANGELOG.md`** — prepend a new entry under `## [Unreleased]` (or create the section if missing):
   ```markdown
   ### Added — PD-08 Definition snapshot (2026-05-21)
   - New `src/definition/snapshot.zig`: `SnapshotStore` that atomically writes an immutable copy of the definition graph to `instance_definition_snapshots` at instance start time.
   - `SnapshotStore.create()` uses `SELECT ... FOR SHARE` + `INSERT ... ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING` to guarantee atomicity and idempotency.
   - `SnapshotStore.getByInstanceId()` retrieves the frozen graph for running instances, isolating them from subsequent definition changes.
   - `src/bpm.zig` now exports `pub const snapshot`.
   ```

3. Update `handoffs/registry.json` — set status of entry `88100006-2605-4000-8008-202605210705` to `COMPLETED`.

4. Set this handoff's own `status` to `COMPLETED` and fill `result` and `completed_at`.
acceptance_criteria: docs/status/requirement_status.json PD-08 entry has status RELEASED
CHANGELOG.md has a new PD-08 entry
